**Daily Devotional**

**April 22**

*5 Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding. 6 In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths. (Proverbs 3:5-6 KJV)*

There are two types of understanding, one is human understanding and the other is the spiritual understanding that we have from God. This is telling us that we should not rely upon our human abilities but upon the abilities of the Lord that we have been given when we are born again (Galatians 4:6). The reason for this is that God has placed the mind of Jesus in our born again spirits (1 Corinthians 2:16), and His mind is so much superior to ours, that we would be foolish to lean on our understanding instead of His.

If we will trust in the Lord to lead us He will (Isaiah 42:16). To be pleasing to the Lord and be able to determine His will for our life, we have to let Him lead us in all our ways. It was not meant for man to follow his own path, but to let God direct our steps (Jeremiah 10:23). To be in God’s will for our lives, we must let Him lead us in all things. As children of the Most High God, we should want to please Him, and do as He would have us to in this life. Praise God that He has given to us the free will (Deuteronomy 30:19) to be able to choose Him, and serve and love Him of our own choice. Thank you Lord.
